name: MAVOS-inspired focal context modulation of SAM2 spatial memory values
status: candidate frozen for engineering gate; efficacy not authorized
research_scope: Exploratory PolypGen study. This cohort informed previous analyses, and sequence-level independence from patients is unverified.

prior_work.adaptation_boundary: Reuse MAVOS's gated depthwise focal levels and global-context modulation equations only. Do not claim to reproduce MAVOS, its dynamic memory, its DeAOT training, or its benchmark scores.

hypothesis: A learned local/global context residual on every spatial memory value token may improve SAM2's object mask decoding while preserving its native query-key matching and retaining all frames and tokens.

method.insertion: In each of SAM2's four memory cross-attention layers, adapt the raw memory value input immediately before the frozen native v_proj.
method.operation: For each concatenated 64x64 spatial frame block independently, apply MAVOS’s context projection; sequentially apply its gated depthwise focal convolutions with kernels 3 and 5; pool global context from the final focal representation; and project the aggregate as a residual added to the original token feature. Initialize the final projection to zero for native identity before training. The integration follows SAM2 MemoryAttention.batch_first: transpose native [batch,tokens,channels] values into the adapter’s token-first grid view and transpose back before v_proj. If a read contains only object-pointer tokens and no spatial frame, pass it through unchanged.
unchanged: all spatial memory tokens and frames
memory writes, image encoder, and mask decoder
method.trainable: Only four focal residual modules; SAM2 remains frozen and in evaluation mode.
method.region_labels: None. This tests token-context modulation, not predicted foreground/background/boundary categories.
method.frames_and_tokens: No frame selection, token deletion, thresholding, or confidence gating. The spatial sequence is parsed as complete 4096-token frame blocks followed by SAM2's pointer-token tail; malformed layouts fail closed.

conditions.C1: Focal value residual with true within-frame spatial neighborhoods.
conditions.C2: Capacity- and training-matched focal residual. Construct P as torch.randperm(4096, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(20261107)); apply P independently to each frame/object grid before focal processing and apply P inverse before the native value projection. This preserves token positions and global context while disrupting local neighborhood structure.

excluded_sequences.seq1: No positive prompt frame under the existing protocol.
excluded_sequences.seq7: No positive prompt frame under the existing protocol.

data.prompt: First labeled frame; score only post-prompt frames.
data.unit: Sequence. Patient-to-sequence mapping is not verified; do not claim patient-independent inference.
data.test_status: Previously examined PolypGen sequences make all PolypGen efficacy results exploratory, including seq16-seq23. External confirmation is required for generalization claims.

training.device: CPU FP32 for the first study, matching the verified author-baseline pipeline; do not switch devices mid-attempt.
training.schedule: Use the same deterministic 480-clip plan and clip order for C1 and C2. Reconstruct it from the frozen plan and save the exact indices before training.
training.loss: Autoregressive present-frame mask BCE/Dice-style loss plus object-presence loss, matching the existing Run174 clip-training path. Ground truth is loss-only after the prompt; predictions feed memory.
training.checkpointing: Save optimizer, scheduler if any, RNG states, completed clip receipts, and module state atomically after every clip. Resume must verify all frozen hashes and reproduce the next sampled clip.

must_pass_before_training_or_efficacy: Synthetic tests: exact identity at zero residual, finite nonzero adapter gradients, unchanged pointer tail, valid frame-block reshape, and fixed permutation/inverse round-trip.
Real-frame seq2 and seq3 gate: zero-initialized C1 and C2 reproduce native SAM2 masks and stored-memory receipts bit-for-bit on every frame.
Verify actual per-frame spatial memory alignment and native spatial plus temporal positional encodings; ensure pointer values and positional encodings remain byte-identical.
Verify all four memory cross-attention layers execute and each receives finite nonzero adapter gradients, while no pretrained SAM2 parameter gets a gradient or changes hash.
Verify a trained one-update adapter changes propagation output, produces finite masks, and safely saves/resumes to the exact next-step output.
Verify persistent multi-object IDs on a real multi-object VOS clip before making a multi-object support claim; PolypGen alone cannot establish this.
Honor SAM2 batch_first layout, including the initial pointer-only read; pointer-only inputs must pass through bit-identically.

evaluation.validation_selection: Select the earliest checkpoint with the highest equal-sequence present-frame Dice over seq13-seq15.
evaluation.release_rule: Run the PolypGen test split only if selected C1 exceeds both C0 and C2 by at least 0.01 equal-sequence mean present Dice, wins on at least 2/3 validation sequences against each, and raises the pooled GT-empty false-alarm rate by no more than 0.02 absolute versus C0. Otherwise stop without test inference.
secondary: paired sequence-level tests with Holm correction
evaluation.native_baseline_reuse: Reuse existing native per-frame receipts only after checkpoint, config, prompt, frame coverage, and prediction hashes match this setup. Otherwise regenerate native once before the adapter efficacy run.
evaluation.external_confirmation: If the PolypGen screen passes, evaluate on an available, licensed DAVIS multi-object split using its official metric implementation and persistent object IDs. Previously inspected DAVIS sequences are exploratory. Do not report SA-V without authorized data access.

provenance.launch_status: Not launched. Do not start the efficacy run until the real-frame gate passes and the protocol/source snapshot is committed.
